#90 - One Man Makes An Army

Chapter 90: One Man Makes an Army

To use a giant hammer to deal with ordinary Western soldiers wearing only one layer of iron armor is like using a butcher knife to kill a chicken.

Moreover, the situation on the field is serious. The law enforcement team and the people brought by Arthur only add up to more than 70 people, and 20 of their own soldiers have been killed.

The Mountain and Amory Lorch's manpower combined are still around 200.

It is too late to use a weapon like a giant hammer that delays Arthur's dexterity.

So he put the giant hammer in the hole where the Mountain's helmet was smashed, then picked up the golden Guandao and rushed towards the Western soldiers wearing scarlet cloaks.

Originally, Arthur thought that the vertical chop was the most handsome, and it could cut the enemy in half at once, but the efficiency was not as high as the horizontal chop.

The golden Guandao was originally a heavy weapon, but in Arthur's hand it was as flexible as a wooden spear.

After a moment, the Western soldiers immediately felt the fear of the members of the King's Landing law enforcement team being dominated by the Mountain a few minutes ago.

With a sweep of the Guandao, Arthur could often push two or three people who hit the blade to rotate half a circle, and then knock down other Western soldiers.

In this way, Arthur's people around him could be gathered together, and then he could send them to see the gods in the sky with two strong cuts.

This behavior is a bit like harvesting wheat, gathering a handful of wheat together with one hand, and then cutting it off with a sickle.

Arthur's efficiency in harvesting the lives of enemies suddenly increased a lot.

He is now just an ordinary old farmer.

However, the Western soldiers are not fools. After a few times of this, a large area around Arthur has been vacated.

The nearby Western soldiers were either killed or kept away from Arthur.

Helplessly, he had to chase the Western soldiers, one by one.

At the other end of the battlefield, the red-robed monk Thoros, wielding the fire sword in his hand, knocked down the enemy in front of him and habitually observed the surroundings.

The long fight was very tiring.

The fatigue from all over his body reminded him of the tournament a month and a half ago. In that group battle, a handsome little noble from Hejian had entangled with him for two hours, causing him to feel almost as tired as he is now.

He felt a little unhappy when he thought of fighting with that little noble.

He was so tired last time, and this time he was so tired for the Hejian people.

While holding on, he immediately saw a scene that he would never forget in his life while observing the situation.

"My God of Light, is that still a human?"

He stared blankly at Arthur, who was wielding a golden sword, cutting an enemy in two with one sword, and then chasing a large group of Westerland soldiers to cut them in half.

With the addition of Arthur, a strong ally, the pressure on the entire King's Landing Law Enforcement Team was greatly reduced.

Thoros was able to get close to Beric Dondarrion and watch Arthur and his dazzling golden sword show off to the whole audience.

It should be said that he chopped the whole audience.

Berri, the Earl of Blackhaven in Stormland, also noticed the little river noble who joined from behind.

He and the red-robed monk looked at each other and saw the surprise and fear in each other's eyes.

Arthur's performance was much more powerful than the Mountain.

At least the Mountain couldn't run after the armor.

"I thought the Mountain's opponent was the most desperate person in the world, but I didn't expect that Arthur's opponent was." Berri sighed.

Thoros shook his head, which made the small bun on his head shake twice.

"Arthur's opponents are not desperate at all. They just need to run faster than their companions. Those who run slower are the most desperate."

After Arthur killed a few of the Westerland soldiers, the situation on the battlefield had reversed.

Although the Lannister soldiers still had the advantage in numbers, they could not withstand Arthur's attack, so these ordinary soldiers of civilian origin stayed away from the battlefield and Arthur.

Amory Lorch was still alive. Seeing that the Mountain was killed, he knew that he was not Arthur's dish, so he shouted to retreat.

Those who survived until now were all the most responsive veterans, and their escape speed was amazing. After hearing someone shouting to retreat, both the Mountain's men and Loki's men ran away to the south.

They took off their armor while running to reduce their weight.

Their speed, flexibility in taking off their armor, and abundant physical strength were enough to make people doubt whether they had really fought hard just now.

The King's Landing Law Enforcement Team and Arthur's men added up to less than a hundred people, and they were not at an advantage in catching up, so they rested on the spot.

The others were already lying on the ground tired, but Arthur was still very energetic.

While checking the battlefield, he stabbed the seriously injured Westerland soldiers a few more times and put his own bodies together.

When Arthur came to the red-robed monk, he was about to stab Thoros, who suddenly opened his eyes, and stared at him.

"I'm not dead yet, what are you going to do?"

Arthur put down the golden Guandao, "I thought you were a mercenary from the West. After all, the law enforcement team from King's Landing are all nobles from the Riverlands and Stormlands. They are all dressed very elegantly, not as sloppy as you."

He recognized Thoros from the small bun, but he couldn't recognize him by face because the blood and scars covered his facial features.

The law enforcement team members lying around sat up when they saw Arthur coming.

"I knew Arthur could kill the Mountain."

"The two championships in the tournament are not to be underestimated."

"Arthur has a lot of blood on his body. Are you injured?"

"Fool, that's the enemy's blood. Arthur is a tough guy wearing two layers of armor."

A group of people chattered and chatted.

Arthur looked around and found that they were all familiar faces.

Raymond Darry, Marco Piper, Khalil Vance, Thoros, Lord Berry and many more.

It can be said that everyone's lives were saved by Arthur and the people he brought, so some people want to repay the favor.

"I see that your plate armor has been cut into holes and is no longer smooth and beautiful." Lord Berry stood up, walked around Arthur, and then said:

"When I return to King's Landing, I will find someone to make you a new pair of plate armor, make it gold, and form a set with your sword and vest."

Ma Ke agreed with this idea and nodded: "Yes, Arthur's giant hammer is black and not worthy of this set. I will find someone to get you a golden giant hammer when I have time."

"If a full set of golden hunks goes on the battlefield, wouldn't it attract the attention of everyone?"

A group of men who were physically and mentally exhausted and covered in blood started chatting around this topic again.

The Arthur they said was not in the mood to pay attention to this. What happened in the next week or two would be enough to affect the entire war situation in the Riverlands and the Western Region.

He has to take heart.

"How's it going in King's Landing?" Arthur asked.

Although he knew what was going to happen, he could still make some mistakes.

"When we set off, the king was still hunting in the royal forest to the south. It was said that a rare white deer appeared." Raymond answered.

When Arthur heard this, he knew that Robert had to go through the process and die.

The white deer had already entered his belly. How could the king hit it?

After thinking for a while, Arthur asked the heirs of Vance and Piper: "Are your two armies still near Golden Teeth City?"

Lord Tywin sent two small troops, indicating that his army was still near Horned Valley City.

Before King Robert died, it was impossible for Tywin to lead an army into the Riverlands himself.

But that was not the case with Jaime's fifteen thousand troops. The Golden Tooth City was originally the territory of the West, and they could start the war without worrying about Robert's life or death.

"It should still be there." Kalel Vance replied.

"Great, James the Kingslayer is heading to the Golden Teeth City, let's catch him." Arthur said.

His idea was to go near Golden Tooth City and then trick the family governors of Vance and Piper into retreating.

After all, there were four thousand of them, and it would not be good to die in vain.

Several people discussed it and thought it was feasible.

"We are a law enforcement team. The regicide should be punished for attacking the King's Hand."

"And Jaime is still a member of the Kingsguard. He fled back to the West without the king's permission. He has violated the oath of the white robes and should be arrested."

Arthur was very satisfied with the reaction of these people, "Then without further ado, let's cross the river and set off now."

Actor's Beach is located near Hongpin City. After crossing the river, it's a day and a half's ride to the west to Golden Teeth City.

Moreover, this is a shoal in the upper reaches of the Red Fork River, and the water flow is small, so you can cross the river without a boat.

Everyone then stood up and directed their subordinates to collect supplies and wounded soldiers.

Half of the small town of Actor's Beach was destroyed by the Magic Mountain, and the remaining two to three hundred residents were called out by Marco Piper, the heir to Pink City, to take charge of cleaning the battlefield and taking care of the wounded soldiers.

"After we leave, you also cross the Red Fork River and seek refuge in Riverrun." Arthur ordered.

Tywin's army will pass through here soon, and this place is no longer safe.

When the residents of Actor's Beach saw that he was a companion of the young master, they agreed.

After gathering the sixty-two people who could still fight, everyone went to look for the body of Magic Mountain.

Some people spit, some people urinate, some people stab them hard with a knife, and some people fart at the magic mountain.

Magic Mountain, who was rampant when he was alive, no longer feels these kind greetings.

In short, everyone who survived vented their anger in their own way.

"Cut off his head and I will use it as a urinal." someone shouted.

"Brother Arthur has smashed it flat. It may not be able to hold your urine."

Earl Berry has the highest status and is relatively stable. He said: "The head of the Magic Mountain is Arthur's honor and should belong to him. His headless body can be propped up on the river beach to shock the passing Western soldiers and refugees." bandit."

Someone obeyed the order.

So Arthur got the smashed head of the Magic Mountain.

Fortunately, what he hit was the back of the head. Although the face in the front was a little flatter, the facial features were very clear, and he could recognize that this was Gregor Clegane.

There was no problem anymore. After bringing some food given by the residents of Actor's Beach, everyone crossed the river on horseback and galloped towards Golden Teeth City.

…

Two days later, Golden Tooth City.

"God of Light, why are you starting to fight again!" Thoros said helplessly.

After traveling hundreds of leagues, they finally reached their destination.

But the picture in front of them made them feel bad.

Crimson robes all over the mountains and plains are attacking the two camps next to the Hejian Avenue.

The castle not far away stood silently, watching the stupidity of human beings killing each other.

"My dad is inside, I have to go in and save him." Marco Piper has a straightforward temper. Seeing that his family's soldiers were surrounded and his dad was still trapped inside, he immediately became anxious and was about to rush in with the people from Pink City. .

"No hurry." Arthur stopped him.

"Look, Jaime the Kingslayer is over there. There are only a few hundred people around him. Let's rush over and kill him."

He pointed at James who was commanding behind the army.

Someone keenly noticed that something was wrong: "There are not just a few hundred people, it would have to be described as too many."

Arthur waved his riding crop and said, "That's what it means anyway. Shoot the horse first if you shoot the man, capture the king first if you capture the thief. My idea is that if James is captured, the army in the West will be in chaos. By then, after defeating Vance and Pai The Bai family was encircled and the enemy commander was captured again. "

Thoros looked at the hundreds of Western soldiers pointed by Arthur, and suddenly felt frightened.

There are only sixty-two of them. Even if they fight one against three, they can defeat less than two hundred people. The remaining enemies will have to go to heaven to meet the gods.

"It's better to rescue Vanspiper's camp. We'll find friendly forces after we kill them through a road, and then bring them out." The red-robed monk said to Earl Berry.

Since this place is at the intersection of the Golden Teeth Mountains and the River Plains, the flat open space is not very wide, so the Lannister soldiers are not fully deployed and can only fight in groups.

This makes the Vance and Piper families look like they can hold on.

The rescue camp is therefore much more feasible.

Earl Berry was only a few months older than Arthur, but he was very mature. "Arthur, why don't you go to the rescue camp with us first and discuss capturing James? After all, they really have a lot of manpower."

Arthur thought for a while and said: "Then you go to the rescue camp first, Angay and Varg, and you also lead people to follow Lord Berry. I wear two layers of armor, which is enough to kill the Lannister army. You don’t have to worry about me.”

"I'm worried about the Kingslayer and the soldiers in the West. You can chop the soldiers as you please, but don't chop James with one knife." Raymond Darry warned.

They are now very confident about Arthur's strength.

Kalel echoed: "That is, Jaime must be alive so that Duke Tywin can cease the war. One of his sons has been kidnapped. If this son also dies, he will go crazy, and then the entire Riverlands will be Disaster."

"No problem at all." Arthur agreed, "There are many enemies here, so take care."

After speaking, he waved his riding crop and let Red Rabbit carry him towards James' military formation.

He left everyone with a tall and charming figure.

The remaining sixty-one people also started to move, and they began to charge towards the two camps on the right.

…

"Stop him." A Lannister officer spotted the charging Arthur and ordered.

"If a person still wants to be a hero, does he think there is no one in the Western Region?"

Dozens of elite Lions wearing lion-shaped half-helmets, black armor, and crimson cloaks faced Arthur, preparing to meet the enemy.

Not far away, James, the commander of the Western Division who was surrounded by people, also discovered Arthur who was charging alone.

At the same time, we also saw our own soldiers on defense.

So he shouted: "His charge alone scared you like this? Come on!"

The officer had no choice but to lead his men to meet him.

A few minutes later, the officer who was split in two by the golden sword was killed.

Before he died, he didn't even have time to greet Mother Jaime, who ordered him to charge.

Half of his men were split in two, and half retreated.

James and many of the nobles in the Western Region were amazed when they saw Arthur scattering dozens of people alone.

"This is so brave, just one person forming an army!"

"I think it's slightly inferior to Magic Mountain."

"At least it's much better than us standing here."

They were just surprised by Arthur's amazing fighting prowess, but they didn't know that the most powerful Demon Mountain in the West had died under this man's hammer.

More soldiers were sent to entangle Arthur in an attempt to stop Arthur riding a giant horse in golden armor.

James was aroused by the words of the people around him.

He yelled: "Let you see who is braver, me or him, get the gun."
